short_description: Corners are wasted space in most kitchens. This stainless steel l-shaped corner work table turns a corner into a continuous work surface, with a brushed flat top, a raised splashback on the wall sides and braced legs on levelling feet. You can stand at the bend and reach both arms, which cuts walking and keeps a whole prep line within arm's reach. sections.heading: Key Features and Benefits
sections.body:
L shape. The two arms meet at a corner, so you use the full length of two walls and gain a large continuous surface.

Brushed stainless steel top. The finish hides scratches, wipes clean in seconds and does not stain or absorb odours.

Raised splashback. The upstand runs along the wall sides, keeping water and food off the walls.

Braced square legs. Cross braces keep the frame rigid and the legs adjust to uneven floors, so the table never rocks.

Open design. Open sides let you slide in crates and bins below and mop beneath easily.

sections.body: Level all four legs on the floor so the arms of the L meet without a gap and check the seams are tight. Work at the corner with ingredients on one arm and finished plates on the other, which cuts steps and speeds up service. Wipe seams with a damp cloth every day so crumbs do not collect, and avoid cutting directly on the top, using boards instead.
